Shooter Hunt: Showdown 1896 News
Hunt Showdown 1896: Bloodskin Is Here – Community Unleashes New Boss
The Hunt community has reached the final Blood Testament stage: Bloodskin is now unlocked. Here’s what you need to know about Hunt Showdown 1896’s new boss.
Sascha Asendorf
Published: September 11th, 2026 3 Min. Lesezeit
0 Comments
Prefer Guided on Google
German English
The mystery of Blood Testament has been solved: The Hunt Showdown community has reached the final stage of the Community Event and unleashed the previously teased nightmare. It turns out to be an entirely new boss called Bloodskin.
That happened faster than expected. Blood Testament only launched in Hunt: Showdown 1896 on September 8, 2026, together with the large Make Them Bleed Community Challenge. Just a few days later, players have already reached the third and final stage. As a result, Bloodskin is now part of the hunt.
Bloodskin Is a New Boss With Two Phases
Crytek also released a new trailer alongside the unlock, giving us our first proper look at the new enemy.
YouTube
External content from YouTube
Show a video from YouTube.
Loading establishes a connection to YouTube. Personal data may be transferred.Load content
Bloodskin is not simply another monster or Wild Target like Rotjaw or Hellborn. Crytek introduces the creature as a proper Boss Target.
The fight changes significantly between its two phases.
At the beginning, Bloodskin is protected by heavy armor. In this state, the boss moves relatively slowly, but can deal heavy damage in close combat. As the fight progresses, its protective shell is destroyed and Bloodskin transforms.
During the second phase, the previously sluggish enemy becomes considerably faster and more agile. Bloodskin can now teleport and uses this ability to surprise Hunters inside its lair before attacking them at close range. Once the second phase has begun, the boss will not return to its armored form.
Defeating Bloodskin also rewards you with the Siphon Burn Trait, which you may already know from the Blood Wells introduced with the current event. Siphon allows you to steal a Scarce Trait when looting an enemy Hunter.
The banishing process also comes with a special twist. Once you begin banishing Bloodskin, monsters in the surrounding area become more aggressive. Their behavior resembles the intense phase of the Blood Moon and remains active throughout the banish.
Crytek Already Teased This Nightmare to Us at Gamescom
The reveal is especially interesting for us because Crytek had essentially been hiding the new boss right in front of us at Gamescom 2026.
During our interview, we directly asked the developers when Hunt: Showdown 1896 would finally receive another new boss. Crytek did not want to give us a clear answer. Instead, the team pointed toward Update 2.9 and a previously unrevealed “new nightmare“ that would be unleashed during Blood Testament.
Considering Crytek responded to our boss question with exactly that hint, a new boss already seemed very likely. However, the developers were not willing to officially confirm it at the time.
Now we know: That nightmare was Bloodskin.
Blood Testament Tells the Story of Warren Russett
Bloodskin also appears to play an important role in the story of the event. Blood Testament revolves around the Hunter Warren Russett, who lost everything to the Corruption. Lynch eventually offers him a newly developed blood serum.
Russett subsequently develops an increasingly powerful thirst for blood and becomes dependent on the serum. Before the event began, Crytek had already announced that players would discover the consequences of these experiments throughout Blood Testament.
The connection between this story and Bloodskin is therefore difficult to ignore. Crytek had specifically announced the third Community Stage as the conclusion, or further escalation, of this storyline.
Whether Bloodskin officially is Warren Russett, however, should still be treated cautiously until Crytek explicitly confirms the connection.
Either way, the Hunt community can now find out for themselves: Bloodskin is available now in Hunt: Showdown 1896.
